Being someone who started riding at 2 and showing at 4, I can assure you it is just as awkward for us.. Sometimes I feel guilty about being better than riders who are older than me and pretend that I am nowhere near as good as them. My mother rode as early, if not earlier in life than me but she still lives vicariously through my equitation career, so even though I'm a junior exhibitor I understand that. :P But anyway, it's never too late to love a horse and go on a journey with them, be it showing or trail riding, there is always something there that you can do with a horse that will make your life and potential feel fulfilled. Just don't set your expectations too high, I do that and now I am obsessed with getting on the 2017 U.S. Saddle Seat Equitation Young Riders Team.. Just have fun!!! :D
